rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for vehicles or aircraft operated without a driver or crew.

example.english: This vehicle is unmanned and can drive itself to pick up passengers.
example.traditional: 呢架車係無人駕駛，自己識得去接載乘客。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaa3 ce1 hai6 mou4 jan4 gaa3 sai2 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 heoi3 zip3 zoi3 sing4 haak3

rows.note: Use this for machines, systems, or equipment that operate without anyone operating them.

example.english: The machine is unmanned and processes orders automatically at night.
example.traditional: 部機器可以無人操作，夜晚都會自動處理訂單。
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 hei3 ho2 ji5 mou4 jan4 cou1 zok3 je6 maan5 dou1 wui6 zi6 dung6 cyu2 lei5 deng6 daan1
